import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
a,b=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
diffs=[(i,j,a[i][j],b[i][j]) for i in range(len(a)) for j in range(len(a[0])) if a[i][j]!=b[i][j]]
print(diffs)
zi=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(a) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==0]
ones=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(a) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==1]
print('zeros',zi); print('ones',sorted(ones))
T=G['Test input']
z2=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(T) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==0]
print('test zeros',z2)
for v in sorted(set(x for r in T for x in r)): print(v, sum(r.count(v) for r in T))

def iso_table(gi):
    gi=norm(gi)
    bgp=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    csx=comps4(gi,bgp)
    Lc=[(c2,cc) for c2,cc in csx if exact_L(cc)]
    col,Lc=max(Lcands,key=lambda x:len(x[1])) if Lcands else (None,None)
    Lset=set(Lc) if Lc else set()
    res=[]
    for a,(ca,cal) in enumerate(csx):
        if set(cal)==Lset: continue
        best=10**9
        for b,(cb,cbl) in enumerate(csx):
            if set(cbl)==set(cal): continue
            for (x,y) in cal:
                for (u,v) in cbl:
                    best=min(best,abs(x-u)+abs(y-v))
        res.append((ca,len(cal),best,sorted(cal)[:3]))
    res.sort(key=lambda t:-t[2])
    return bgp,res

def comp_feats(gi, changed):
    gi=norm(gi)
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgp=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    csx=comps4(gi,bgp)
    Lcx=[(c2,cc) for c2,cc in csx if exact_L(cc)]
    Lcol,Lset=(max(Lcx,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))[0], set(max(Lcx,key=lambda x:len(x[1]))[1])) if Lcx else (None,set())
    corner=None
    if Lset:
        lcells=sorted(Lset)
        # corner = cell whose two neighbor-in-L dirs are perpendicular
        for (r0,c0) in lcells:
            nb=[(r0+dr,c0+dc) in Lset for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]]
            if sum(nb)==2 and nb[0]==nb[2]==True or (nb[0] and nb[2]) or (nb[1] and nb[3]): pass
        # simpler: corner = the L cell with both a row-neighbor and col-neighbor in L
        for (r0,c0) in lcells:
            if ((r0,c0-1) in Lset or (r0,c0+1) in Lset) and ((r0-1,c0) in Lset or (r0+1,c0) in Lset):
                corner=(r0,c0)
    rows=[]
    for a,(ca,cal) in enumerate(csx):
        if set(cal)==Lset: continue
        cells=set(cal)
        # iso
        iso=10**9
        for b,(cb,cbl) in enumerate(csx):
            if set(cbl)==cells: continue
            for (x,y) in cal:
                for (u,v) in cbl:
                    iso=min(iso,abs(x-u)+abs(y-v))
        dL=10**9; dC=10**9
        for (x,y) in cal:
            for (u,v) in Lset: dL=min(dL,abs(x-u)+abs(y-v))
            if corner: dC=min(dC,abs(x-corner[0])+abs(y-corner[1]))
        rows.append(dict(col=ca,n=len(cal),iso=iso,dL=dL,dC=dC,minr=min(x for x,y in cal),
            minc=min(y for x,y in cal),maxc=max(y for x,y in cal),maxr=max(x for x,y in cal),
            cells=sorted(cal),tgt=bool(cells&changed),corner=corner,Lcol=Lcol,bgp=bgp,H=H,W=W,Ln=len(Lset)))
    return rows
